t: This is 22 Weymouth Street, a Grade II listed house in the City of Westminster. It was built in 1934 by Bovis to a design by the brothers Giles Gilbert Scott and Adrian Gilbert Scott. It's notable for combining traditional and modernist elements. Giles is also known for Battersea Power Station, Liverpool Cathedral and the iconic red telephone box, while Adrian was an ecclesiastical architect. Look at how the house balances the old and the new.
